candidates.title: Tesla inaugurates Sparks Semi factory and starts customer handovers at a 50,000-a-year target
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Sept 24 Nevada event opened the dedicated Semi plant and a redesigned truck; long-range claimed at 500 loaded miles and about 300 miles recovered in 30 minutes on a Megacharger

candidates.title: ZET SCALE names Tesla primary OEM for up to 2,500 Class 8 trucks
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Largest US electric Class 8 order, but Kenworth, RIDE, and Volvo are secondary OEMs and the Semi share of the 2,500 is unpublished

candidates.title: EU FSD vote slips off the Oct 6 TCMV agenda to December at the earliest
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Draft agenda gives the Dutch Article 39 request 25 minutes of discussion and no vote; Musk replied 'sigh'

candidates.title: Czechia recognizes Dutch FSD Supervised approval, seventh EU country
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Ministry of Transport recognized the April RDW file on Sept 21; Tesla Europe says rollout starts soon, still SAE Level 2 and HW4 first

candidates.title: Brussels group says FSD sped in 55% of tested 30 km/h zones
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Johanna.be FSD30 study, published Sept 24, says the car often showed 50 km/h in 30 zones; independent of Tesla's own Belgian safety stats

candidates.title: Optimus output hits several hundred a week, but robots still cannot generalize
candidates.whyItMightMatter: The Information says Fremont rose from dozens a week in Q2 to several hundred, with a 1,000-a-week year-end aim, while most units stay internal and basic tasks take days to learn

candidates.title: Austin robotaxi active count falls back to 8 vehicles after the Cybercab launch spike
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Robotaxi Tracker seven-day active Austin fleet is back to the June 2025 level even as Texas registrations keep climbing

candidates.title: Texas robotaxi registrations hit 420 Model Ys and 126 Cybercabs
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Combined Texas roster at 546, with Cybercabs up from 58 last week and 69 on Sept 24; registrations are not the same as cars giving rides

candidates.title: First Cybercab built with in-house Giga Texas nickel cathode
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Robotaxi account and Musk say the car used cathode from what they call the first cathode plant in the Americas, tying 4680 material supply to Cybercab

candidates.title: Tesla Android app assets leak an Optimus Gen 3 design
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Signed app files labeled Gen 3 show covered joints versus exposed Gen 2.5 hardware; Tesla has not confirmed the art is the production robot

candidates.title: Tesla confirms FSD v14.3.9 false dirty-camera alerts and cancels service visits
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Support told owners the clean-windshield warning on 2026.27.5/2026.27.6 is a software bug; v14.3.10 notes still do not say it is fixed

candidates.title: FSD v14.2 Lite starts reaching HW3 Model S and Model X
candidates.whyItMightMatter: First v14 Lite builds for redesigned HW3 S/X on 2026.27.10 and 2026.27.11; wave is small and legacy S/X are still waiting

candidates.title: Tesla China extends Model 3/Y discounts through Oct 31 and cuts the Model Y incentive
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Tail-payment cut stays CNY 5,000 on Model 3 but drops from CNY 10,000 to CNY 7,000 on Model Y for orders delivered by Oct 31

candidates.title: US Model 3 and Model Y L new-order delivery estimates slip into early 2027
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Cheapest Model 3 quotes January-March 2027 and Model Y L quotes January-February 2027, a sold-out signal separate from sell-side delivery cuts

candidates.title: Large Cybercab and Model Y robotaxi lot spotted in Houston
candidates.whyItMightMatter: Sept 19 footage shows a packed Houston staging lot, including Starlink-equipped Cybercabs, but no Cybercab service launch has been announced
